ui.quickFillEmpty: No scale items are available for quick fill.

ui.exportLayoutModernDesc: Detailed category tables with color-coded pills for easy reading.
ui.exportLayoutClassicDesc: Compact multi-column sheet with traditional color-coded circles.
ui.exportSelectLayoutPrompt: Choose Modern View or Classic View above to display the complete summary and unlock the export buttons.
ui.stepIncompleteAlert: Please complete all items in this step before continuing.
ui.privacyNotice: Local privacy: your responses never leave your browser.
ui.themeSoberDesc: Black & white with blue accents and gradient
ui.a11yAudioAssistHint: Speaks focused items, responses, and alerts using browser speech synthesis.
ui.a11yVisualCaptionsHint: Displays a high-contrast caption bar for spoken cues and alerts.

ui.autosaveSavedNow: Responses saved encrypted in your browser.
ui.modePickerTitle: How would you like to fill out the checklist?
ui.modePickerSubtitle: Choose the layout that best fits your pace. You can switch modes at any time without losing your answers.

ui.modePickerStepperHow: Answer all items in the current step, advance through categories, and review everything in Final Review before exporting.

ui.modePickerFullDesc: All categories and items expanded on one page with quick category jump shortcuts.
ui.modePickerFullHow: Scroll freely through the complete list or jump straight to any category using the quick-nav bar at the top.
ui.modePickerQuickFillDesc: One-item-at-a-time focus mode built to complete the checklist in minutes.
ui.modePickerQuickFillHow: Press keys 1–6 (or click an option) to select a scale and auto-advance; press 0 to clear or ↑/↓ to navigate.
ui.modePickerImportTitle: Already have a saved JSON draft?
ui.modePickerImportDesc: Import a previously exported .json file to restore all your responses and keep editing or export again.
ui.checklistCompletedMessage: All visible questions have been answered. You can review your choices or export your result now.
